name: prefers-reduced-data
plain: User wants less data use (data saver).
meaning: Pairs with Save-Data. Still behind a flag in Chrome, so almost always no-preference.

access.persistence: read fresh on every page load; nothing stored
access.iframe: Readable from cross-origin iframes too (same values)

limits.headline: Can tell if you asked for less data use, where the browser supports it
limits.user_action: Nothing. It happens when the page loads.
can: Check whether a data saver setting is on
Send smaller images and skip autoplay video
Add the answer to a browser fingerprint
cannot: See your data plan or how much you have used
Get an answer in Safari or on iPhone
Get an answer in Chrome unless that hidden setting is switched on
limits.reach_label: One yes or no, rarely on
limits.differs: Only Chrome based browsers and Firefox have it, and only behind a hidden setting. Safari does not.

story.what_it_is: Tells a page you want it to use less data, such as in a data saver mode.

marketing.name: prefers-reduced-data
marketing.pitch: Documents a media feature that lets pages send lighter content when the person wants to save data.

story.for_you: You never see the check. If you turned on data saver, a site may skip big videos and use smaller pictures to save your plan.
story.for_makers: Makers use it to cut weight for people on slow or costly mobile plans. It also tells them the person may be in a place with weak internet, which is a small private clue.

use_cases.example: A news site shows still images instead of auto playing video when data saver is on.
A browser game loads smaller textures and skips cut scenes so it starts faster on a weak connection.
An ad network sends a lighter ad or none when a user wants to save data.
A store loads small thumbnails and delays the product video in data saver mode.
A social app turns off auto play and loads lower quality photos.
A learning site offers a text version of a lesson for students on limited plans.

legit_uses: Respect OS theme and accessibility needs
abuse: Infer disability or setting for fingerprinting
